turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Guests keep asking for my wifi password and it's this long random thing. Embarrassing.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can share it with a QR code instead. Go to your wifi settings, tap your network, and there's usually a share option.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, and another thing. I'm running my first half marathon in May and I want a proper playlist.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Nice. Would you like steady songs with the same tempo the whole way, or a playlist that builds up energy towards the end?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And then we could— oh, Daniel needs me. One minute, Moshi.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you done with the newspaper?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Take it, I only read the sports page.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, any chance you could feed the cat while we're away?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Nine days. Just once a day, and maybe scoop the litter.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Nine days of litter. You owe me big.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll bring you back something nice. Chocolate? A fridge magnet?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Not a magnet. Something edible, please.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Edible it is. I'll leave the spare key under the plant.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Text me her food amounts, I'll forget otherwise.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Back with you. Go for it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, for race day, which kind of playlist are you after?
